name: Building New Church
overview: Scripture reveals that building a new church is fundamentally dependent on the Lord's blessing and guidance, as emphasized in Psalms 127:1, which declares that without the Lord's involvement, human efforts are in vain. Nehemiah 2:20 highlights the commitment of God's servants to arise and build, trusting in His prosperity. The foundation of the church is Christ Himself, the 'rock' upon which the church is established, as Jesus declares in Matthew 16:18, promising its enduring strength against opposition. Furthermore, true worship in spirit and truth is central to the church's life and mission, aligning with the Father's desire for genuine worshippers, as taught in John 4:23.
